title: Advanced Hook Launchers
description: Adds different hooks with launchers that give you the ability to climb, abseil, jump off cliffs, pull entities or players, and even slay dragons!
body:
![Hook Launchers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90ceaf5818afda6dbfb400c4905f8657fdef49b6.png)

Master the art of grappling with Advanced Hook Launchers - a physics-driven traversal mod that turns exploration into acrobatic adventure.

Launch three specialized hooks with distinct mechanics: the powerful Pudge for combat and entity pulling, the versatile Spear for long-distance climbing and damage, and the elastic Web for safe swinging and momentum-based movement.

Dual-wield your hooks, swing with momentum, perform Tarzan jumps, and feel the authentic weight of your targets as physics realistically impact your grappling mechanics. 


## Key Features
### Advanced and Realistic Physics
Authentic physics simulation for grappling mechanics, ensuring immersive and challenging gameplay.

### Multi-Hook Deployment
Launch and control multiple hooks at once for advanced maneuvering and puzzle-solving.

### Full Multiplayer Support
Play cooperatively with others; physics interactions apply to all players simultaneously.

### Extensive Customization
Fine-tune every aspect of your grappling system:

- Hook strength and fire resistance
- Rope color, length, and elasticity
- Launcher durability and reeling speed


### Weight-Based Physics System
The relative weight between you and your target directly affects interaction - heavier targets require more force or additional help. (Hint: attempting to land a dragon solo won't end well!)

### Rope Integrity Limits
Each hook has a maximum weight capacity; exceeding it causes failure.

### Dynamic Tension Mechanics
Rope tension is calculated based on elasticity, creating realistic resistance and momentum effects.

### Pudge Hook
- Attachment: Tree leaves, poles, iron bars, and fences
- Special abilities: Rips out torches, bells, and lanterns; pulls entities and players; dismounts riding entities
- Auto-pulling: Yes
- Distance: Medium
- Hook strength: High
- Fire resistance: High

### Spear Hook
- Attachment: Any block except high-hardness blocks (metal blocks, obsidian, etc.)
- Special abilities: Breaks glass; deals damage to entities on impact
- Distance: Long
- Rope elasticity: Medium
- Fire resistance: Medium

### Web Hook
- Attachment: Any surface except sandy blocks
- Special abilities: Safe for other players (no damage dealt)
- Distance: Long
- Rope elasticity: High
- Fire resistance: Low

**REQUIRES** [**ForgeEndertech**](https://modrinth.com/project/forgeendertech) **library**
